description: R82: the leading-baryon split of the baryonic continuum roots (F = 0.2, kappa = 4) on the R78e contract, the two-component fit refitted

texts.parametrization_space: epsilon, log B_SD, epsilon_nd, logit w_excited, log flavor weights, f_isovector
texts.report_title: R82: the leading-baryon split on the R78e contract
texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines, the sibling weight at the edge mass (the committed rule, control); the exact 2 -> 2 transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the flat three-body phase space; the model bins converted to the tabulated points (the bin-center correction); the isovector exchange fraction free; diffractive shapes free. The leading-baryon split: a share 0.2 of the baryonic continuum roots decays into its established baryon and a mesonic continuum state of mass mu, flat in ln mu^2, the baryon along the incoming baryon with exp(4 cos theta).
texts.obligation: the two-component fit with the leading-baryon split of the excited baryonic systems (R82)
texts.hypothesis: The R78e kernel with the leading-baryon split (a share F = 0.2 of the baryonic continuum roots decays into its baryon and a mesonic continuum state, the baryon directed along the incoming baryon) describes the six p+p species and the neutron dN/dx_F better than R78e (chi2 27,114); the fit reports the parameters and the residual map as measured.

kernel_change.diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the baryon's energy share in the cascade; the leading-baryon split at the R78e optimum)
kernel_change.sibling_weight: the committed q* at the fixed mass max(floor, edge - nominal width) (control)
kernel_change.bin_center: each model bin average of f is multiplied by f(x0, p0) / <f>_bin of the data's own local shape: an error-weighted five-point quadratic in log f along x_F and along p_T through the tabulated neighbors, the tangent at the end of a row; the neutron dN/dx_F by the one-dimensional factor
kernel_change.sqrt_s: the observables boost, x_F and pi sqrt(s) at the exact invariant mass 17.2702 GeV; the draw domain at 17.270
kernel_change.unchanged: the exact transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the three-body phase-space law, the continuation law (density with the P-wave barrier), the source density, the catalog, the flavor ledger, the edge sibling weight, the bin-center correction
kernel_change.leading_split: at a baryonic continuum root (depth 0) the one channel uniform picks, with probability 0.2, a split channel (an established baryon and a mesonic continuum daughter) on the split channels' weights; the remainder's mu^2 is flat in ln mu^2 on [floor^2, edge^2] at the density uniform; the baryon's direction in the root frame follows exp(4 cos theta) about the incoming baryon (the sign of the root's c.m. p_z); the later steps are the committed cascade (2026-10-08)

texts.shapes_note: the class fractions stay at the external anchors (diffraction is the owner's global-fit question); the diffractive epsilon and B_SD are free
texts.central_component_basis: R74 and R75 found f_central compatible with zero (intervals 0-0.046 and 0-0.040) on the clamped transfer draw; the barrier-radius probe of 2026-10-06 found the central soft region overfilled without a central component at r0 = 1.0, 2.85 and 5.07 GeV^-1 on the exact window
